macanudo--cafe.description: General Cigar's flagship Macanudo, rolled in the Dominican Republic, wraps a long-filler blend of Dominican and Mexican leaf in golden Connecticut Shade. It smokes soft and creamy, with cedar in the lead, coffee bean and nuts beneath and only a light touch of spice; mellow enough for newer smokers.

thirds.notes: Soft and creamy from the first draws, cedar in front with a faint sweetness and a hint of citrus.
The cedar deepens and a gentle spice shows on the finish; the body fills out a little while the texture stays smooth.
Cedar keeps the lead over lingering cream, the spice stays subtle and the smoke never turns harsh.

sources.title: After Action Cigars – Macanudo Café Hyde Park review

macanudo--maduro.description: The maduro side of the Macanudo range dresses a mellow Dominican and Mexican long-filler blend, including Piloto Cubano, in dark Connecticut Broadleaf. It stays gentle in strength but adds sweetness: dark chocolate, molasses and nuts with a little spice, an easy step into darker cigars after dinner.

thirds.notes: Smooth and sweet, cocoa and cedar over a faint pepper in the background.
The sweetness grows into mocha and dark chocolate, with a light woody edge and plenty of creamy smoke.
Coffee and dark chocolate come forward with some pepper for a firmer close, still without bitterness.

macanudo--cru-royale.description: Cru Royale is Macanudo in sun-grown dress: an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over a Dominican La Vega Especial binder and Brazilian Mata Fina, Dominican and Nicaraguan filler, made in the Dominican Republic. Fuller than the shade lines, it draws earthy and nutty, with leather, cocoa and spice; a medium cigar for the afternoon.

thirds.notes: Pepper at the light settles into roasted nuts and earth, with soft milky cocoa underneath and a hint of dark fruit.
The wrapper's earthy spice takes over from the nuts; cocoa powder returns with a plain brown-sugar sweetness.
A salty note wakes the nuttiness again, and the close turns malty with a dry sweetness.

sources.title: Klaro Cigars – Macanudo Cru Royale review
Cigar Obsession – Macanudo Cru Royale Robusto review

macanudo--gold-label.description: A limited, seasonal Macanudo made in the Dominican Republic, Gold Label uses golden Connecticut Shade from the first and second primings over Dominican and Mexican San Andrés tobacco. Mild and sweet, it shows buttered toast, sweet cream and coffee, with cedar, almond and a soft spice, a delicate and gentle smoke.

macanudo--inspirado-black.description: Inspirado Black, made at General Cigar Dominicana, pairs a dark Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper with an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and sits heavier than the classic Macanudo. Mocha, coffee and wood lead, with toasted nuts and a thread of pepper; a richer, evening Macanudo for coffee or a dark spirit.

thirds.notes: A brief burst of white pepper gives way to sweet, chocolate-led mocha, a touch of berry and wood.
The chocolate yields to coffee; wood and berry stay in the background and the pepper builds late in the third.
Earth joins the coffee as chocolate and berry fade, and the body deepens toward medium-full.

sources.title: Cigar Coop – Macanudo Inspirado Black Robusto review

macanudo--inspirado-orange.description: First launched in Europe in 2014, Inspirado Orange is the Honduran member of the Inspirado family: a Honduran wrapper and binder over Honduran, Dominican and Nicaraguan filler, rolled in Honduras. Medium and earthy, it brings cedar, coffee and leather with an anise sweetness and a mineral, peppery edge.

thirds.notes: Black pepper, mineral earth and wood up front, sweet anise on the retrohale and a baking spice toward the transition.
The flavours thin a little; wood, mineral and pepper remain, with a cherry-and-raisin bread sweetness for one taster.
Wood comes forward and strength builds toward the finish, with an aroma like a spice cabinet.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Macanudo Inspirado Orange Toro

macanudo--inspirado-red.description: Inspirado Red, rolled in Nicaragua, wraps an Ecuadorian Habano ligero leaf around a Jalapa binder and filler from Ometepe, Jamastran and Estelí, aged between five and twelve years. Spicier than most Macanudo, it shows coffee, cocoa and cedar with leather and roasted nuts, turning sweeter toward caramel as it burns.

thirds.notes: Bitter cocoa and espresso open with leather and pepper, a little rough until the first half-inch has burned.
Sweeter and nuttier, with cocoa, almond and earth, while charred cedar and a light caramel come through.
Coffee and dark caramel deepen, cedar stays prominent and the pepper returns with a hint of cinnamon.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Macanudo Inspirado Red Robusto
Stogie Review – Macanudo Inspirado Red Robusto
Cigar Dojo – Macanudo Inspirado Red Robusto review

macanudo--inspirado-white.description: Inspirado White, made in the Dominican Republic, wraps a six-year-aged Ecuadorian Connecticut leaf around an Indonesian binder and filler from Condega, Jalapa and San Andrés. Mild to medium and creamy, it tastes of buttered toast, coffee with cream and grain, with a peppery edge that keeps it lively.

thirds.notes: Sweet bread grain and coffee with heavy cream, and a strong peppercorn bite that soon melts into the sweetness.
Mostly buttery and sweet, close to butterscotch, with a light woodiness; hay appears near the band.
Minerality and a light fruity sweetness over creamy, slightly vegetal earth.

sources.title: Cigar Dojo – Macanudo Inspirado White Robusto review

macanudo--inspirado-green.description: Inspirado Green is the first Inspirado to use Brazilian tobacco: an Arapiraca wrapper over an Indonesian binder and Colombian and Dominican filler. Medium-bodied, it balances an earthy sweetness with nuts and black pepper, opening up around the middle; a cigar for bourbon, rye or a hoppy beer.

thirds.notes: Peppery from the start, with a faint chocolate note behind it.
A hint of cinnamon joins in and an earthy flavour arrives around the halfway mark.
Sweet and savoury notes come together fully as the flavour grows to medium-full.

sources.title: Cigar World – Macanudo Inspirado Green review

macanudo--emissary-espana.description: The first Emissary, released in 2024 and rolled in Honduras, is built on Havana-seed tobacco grown near Riolobos in Spain, blended with Dominican, Nicaraguan and Colombian leaf under a light Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper and a Condega binder. Medium-bodied and smooth, it offers natural sweetness, cedar, almond and caramel with a little leather.

thirds.notes: Naturally sweet tobacco with a hint of spice, then earth, leather and caramel in balance, none of them dominant.
Leather moves ahead as earth and caramel recede, and a brief cedar note appears past the midpoint.
The smoke grows smoother still and stays even to the end, still medium in body.

sources.title: Cigar Czars – Macanudo Emissary España review

macanudo--emissary-france.description: The second Emissary, from 2025, centres on four-year-aged tobacco grown in south-western France near Bordeaux, joined by Brazilian Arapiraca, Dominican Piloto Cubano and US Broadleaf, under a ten-year-aged Ecuadorian Habano wrapper and Broadleaf binder. It smokes rich and fruit-led, with dried fruit, dark berries and a faint salinity; a match for red wine.

macanudo--maduro-vintage-2013.description: Released in 2023, this Vintage Maduro uses Connecticut Broadleaf from the hot 2013 summer, a thick and oily leaf, over a Honduran Olancho San Agustín binder and Brazilian Mata Fina, Nicaraguan Jalapa and Piloto Cubano filler. Bolder than the core Macanudo, it shows pepper, leather, mocha and espresso.

thirds.notes: Heavy black pepper at first, settling with leather in front and a creamy, peppery finish.
Creamy smoke; dark chocolate softens toward milk chocolate and the leather gives way to espresso and mocha.
Char returns and the sweetness goes, leaving dry leather, cedar, oak bark and black pepper.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Macanudo Vintage Maduro 2013 Robusto

macanudo--ecuadorian-shade.description: Introduced in 2026 alongside the Sumatra, this box-pressed Macanudo is made in Estelí, with a cloud-grown Ecuadorian Shade wrapper over a Broadleaf binder. It keeps the house's smooth, creamy character but adds more layers: toasted almond, vanilla cream and a soft spice, for unhurried, easy moments.

macanudo--estate-reserve-flint-knoll.description: A limited series made with the Flint Knoll winery, this Estate Reserve rests its tobacco in French oak barrels that held the winery's Cabernet Sauvignon. Release No. 3, from 2024, pairs an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper with a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and Brazilian, Dominican and Nicaraguan filler, giving cedar, vanilla and nuts.

sources.title: Cigar World – Macanudo Estate Reserve Flint Knoll Release No. 3
